entities.name: PMID:25451626
observations: In rats, intramuscular DHPG (a group I mGlu1/5 agonist) in masseter muscle caused mechanical hyperalgesia.
TRPV1 antagonist AMG9810 attenuated DHPG-evoked hyperalgesia; a TRPV1-AKAP decoy peptide also suppressed it.
DHPG increased TRPV1 serine phosphorylation at S800 in dissociated trigeminal ganglia; a PKC inhibitor suppressed this phosphorylation and prevented DHPG-enhanced TRPV1 sensitivity.

entities.name: NCBI:TRPV1
observations: Rat Trpv1 is the TRPV1 channel implicated in the PMID:25451626 masseter hyperalgesia mechanism.

entities.name: NCBI:GRM1
observations: Rat Grm1 encodes a group I metabotropic glutamate receptor investigated as part of mGlu1/5 activation in PMID:25451626.
